title: Fraud-detection-in-financial-transactions
summary: An AI-based fraud detection system that generates synthetic fraudulent transaction samples with CTGAN, WGAN, and SDG-GAN to balance an imbalanced dataset, then trains Random Forest and Autoencoder classifiers for real-time prediction via a Flask app. One notebook imports SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and SingleTableMetadata to fit and sample the CTGAN synthetic data used for this balancing.
